title: Honest Research
grammar: Duty and prohibition: köteles, kénytelen, nem szabad
goal: I can say what a researcher must and must not do (*köteles*, *kénytelen*, *nem szabad*).
I can name the words of research ethics (*adatintegritás*, *szakmai lektorálás*, *kutatási etika*).
I can write one sentence about a researcher's duty.
